built_in_model_policy: The desktop app and Python library expose exactly the four scoring functions reported in the article. Endocrine disruption remains a separate auxiliary hazard signal.
notes: The pesticide scorer remains tied to the dedicated Pesticides class and does not merge Agrochemical Information into the target definition.
The pesticide scorer includes fifteen atom-neighborhood fragments selected in all three held-out molecule-fragment network random-walk folds; original-benchmark AUC increased from 0.7527 to 0.7795.

Flavoring agents and fragrances were merged because their positive sets shared 1,071 structures and their original functions used near-identical descriptor and motif logic; the merged function showed held-out AUC 0.842-0.868 across three folds.
Animal-drug and human-drug functions were excluded because QED already represents general drug-likeness.
Cosmetics, food-contact-substance, food-additive, and solvent functions were excluded after exact-overlap-controlled screening showed inadequate threshold specificity.
Desktop and Python scoring remain local-first so confidential molecular structures do not need to be submitted to a hosted service.
